attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "This fixes a bug where Convert.ToString(attribute) was called on the TagHelperAttribute object itself instead of its .Value, previously likely producing incorrect/empty strings for cache-id, cache-context, id, alternate, and wrapper attributes—the fix is low-risk and targeted, but changes runtime behavior for tag helpers using these attributes, which could surface previously-masked bugs in downstream themes/modules relying on the old (broken) output."}
